fields.description: Automatic series for the membership number.
fields.label: Series

fields.description: Whose membership this is.
fields.label: Member

fields.description: The type this membership is on: its fee, duration, certificate, and whether it needs approval.
fields.label: Membership Type

fields.description: The branch this membership belongs to. Decides who can see it and where approval routes.
fields.label: Geo Node

fields.description: Where the membership stands: awaiting payment or approval, active, expired or cancelled. Set by the system.
fields.label: Membership Status
fields.options:
Draft
Awaiting Payment
Awaiting Approval
Active
Expired
Cancelled

fields.description: The previous membership this one continues. Empty on a first membership.
fields.label: Renews

fields.description: Applicant details from the public registration form. Copied to the person's Red Profile and cleared on save.
fields.label: Registration Intake

fields.description: Given name from the public registration form. Copied to the applicant's Red Profile and cleared on save.
fields.label: Applicant First Name

fields.description: Family name from the public registration form. Copied to the applicant's Red Profile and cleared on save.
fields.label: Applicant Last Name

fields.description: Telephone number from the public registration form. Copied to the applicant's Red Profile and cleared on save.
fields.label: Applicant Phone

fields.description: Gender from the public registration form. Copied to the applicant's Red Profile and cleared on save.
fields.label: Applicant Gender

fields.description: Date of birth from the public registration form. Copied to the applicant's Red Profile and cleared on save.
fields.label: Applicant Date of Birth

fields.description: When this membership took effect. Set at activation.
fields.label: Valid From

fields.description: When it lapses, worked out from the type's duration. Empty for a lifetime membership.
fields.label: Valid To

fields.description: The payment transaction this membership is waiting on.
fields.label: Payment Transaction

fields.description: The gateway's receipt number, where one is provided.
fields.label: Payment Receipt

fields.description: When the payment was confirmed. Set automatically.
fields.label: Paid On

fields.description: How the fee was settled: through the payment gateway, or by proof of a payment made before this system.
fields.label: Source

fields.description: Evidence of a payment made before this system — a receipt or a stamped record. Required when Source is Proof.
fields.label: Proof Attachment

fields.description: What the applicant says about the membership they already hold. Claims, not facts — nothing here decides how long this membership is valid for.
fields.label: Claimed Membership

fields.description: The date the applicant says they originally registered or joined. This is not the date they paid, and not necessarily the date their membership became active.
fields.label: Claimed Start Date

fields.description: The date the applicant says their membership runs to. Empty for a lifetime plan.
fields.label: Claimed Expiry Date

fields.description: The membership number the applicant was given, if they still have it.
fields.label: Claimed Membership Number

fields.description: The branch or place the applicant says they registered at, in their own words. Deliberately not a Geo Node: it is a claim about the past, at a branch this society may since have merged or renamed.
fields.label: Claimed Branch Or Location

fields.description: A certificate or receipt number from the original registration, if the applicant has one.
fields.label: Claimed Certificate Or Receipt Number

fields.description: What somebody at this society confirmed against the evidence. These are the only dates that decide membership validity, and they are never filled in from the claim.
fields.label: Verified By The Society

fields.description: The start date an approver confirmed against the proof. Set through the review screen, never by the applicant.
fields.label: Verified Start Date

fields.description: The expiry date an approver confirmed against the proof. Left empty for a lifetime plan.
fields.label: Verified Expiry Date

fields.description: Who confirmed the dates against the evidence.
fields.label: Verified By

fields.description: What the applicant agreed to, with the wording and version they agreed to it under.
fields.label: Declarations

fields.description: Answers to the extra questions this society asks, with the wording used at the time.
fields.label: Answers

fields.description: Where the approval stands. Set by the approval engine.
fields.label: Approval State
fields.options:
Draft
Submitted
In Review
Approved
Rejected
Withdrawn
Expired

fields.description: The approval stage under review. Set by the approval engine.
fields.label: Approval Stage

fields.description: When the current approval stage was entered. Used to measure how long a decision is taking.
fields.label: Stage Entered On

fields.description: Who decided what, when and why. Written by the approval engine.
fields.label: Approval Decisions

fields.description: The code a printed card is verified by. Minted with the first card and never changed.
fields.label: Card Token
